item.content:encoded: The images that were used in this article are non-compliant with the SCP wiki's license (CC BY-SA 3.0) as the first image couldn't be sourced and the second image is copyrighted by Jan Grarup (as indicated here). Thus, the images have been removed.

item.content:encoded: Added some tags that I think were missing. However, I must admit that the "visual" aspect is presented as a theory, so that one is on the fence. Cognitohazard seems appropriate, though. "Swarm" is the only one on which I'm certain.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I loved this part:

A focus in media coverage during the off season will be sensationalist stories designed to increase everyday paranoia and form habits in viewers conductive to personal safety.

I strongly wish this part wasn't blocked out as I want to know what this effect is called!

Victims of this effect (known as the R█████ effect, in honor of the late Doctor R█████)

I think this quote breaks the tone a bit and doesn't really fit in here (imo):

experience a strong sense that they are somehow protected; quote, "everything is perfectly fine. You're totally safe, and nothing bad can happen."

I feel like they wouldn't just cut off a word like this here but I didn't change it because it seems someone left it that way. (but I wanted to change it):

entering containme[THIS SECTION REMOVED BY ORDER OF O5-8].

I want to know more about this idea, because I like it:

If the SCP-820 swarm can be raised properly in containment, it may be helpful in preparing personnel for work with Keter level SCP objects.

All in all, upvote, but could use some tweaks imho.

It's good, I like it, and it's upvoted, for most of the above reasons.

I know I'm hardly in a position to criticize run-on sentences, but Gerald was just yelling at me this morning for stuff like this on my sandbox…

In addition to this, media coverage in the affected areas will be controlled to encourage citizens to remain indoors and in a safe place until swarm season has ended. A focus in media coverage during the off season will be sensationalist stories designed to increase everyday paranoia and form habits in viewers conductive to personal safety.

and

experience heightened accidental death rates due to an as yet unexplained effect theorized to be a pseudo-hypnotic mental state caused by the constant color and motion of SCP-820.
